patches.name: Offline fix
patches.description: Turns off everything but Beatmap downloads; metadata updates; leaderboards; profile lookups and replay downloads. Every other patch builds on top of this one.

patches.name: Local profiles
patches.description: A fully local, overengineered profile page. I really recommend to try it if you also do content!

patches.name: P2P multiplayer
patches.description: Very early test: Play -> multi opens a P2P lobby. Share an 8 symbol code to let others on your network join; they float around your avatar. No gameplay yet.

patches.name: Interface adjustments
patches.description: Various small UI tweaks that should be in base lazer, but not yet. Check GitHub for every change

patches.name: Search adjustments
patches.description: Search keywords for your own local plays: scorewithmod= (also scoreswithmod= / playwithmod=) shows only beatmaps you have a play on with the given mods, and playdate= (also scoredate= / datescore=) with < > = filters by when the play was set, e.g. playdate<=180d or playdate>4w. Both together match the same play. Uses the scores osu! already keeps, nothing new is stored.

patches.name: Pause PP penalty
patches.description: Optional PP reduction for pausing (7% per pause, from Torii by ShikkesoraSIM), on every map. Pauses before the first object, in breaks or after the last object are free. Settings > Patchsu > Patch 4. Adds a pause counter skin component.

patches.name: Replay toggles
patches.description: Turn visual and pitch mods on and off while watching a replay.

patches.name: PP simulation
patches.description: A results-style panel where you can simulate scores directly in-game (osu!std only ruleset for now).

patches.name: PP aware beatmap carousel
patches.description: Ritsu feature ported to clean lazer instead of depending on Torii. Right-click on "Show converts".

patches.name: Return mod compatability
patches.description: Settings → Patchsu → Patch 8. Hard Rock + Mirror for now.

patches.name: No Fail disabling
patches.description: Settings → Patchsu → Patch 9. Also an option to remove No Fail score reduction.

patches.name: Collection folders
patches.description: Sub-collections: a collection named "Parent/Child" sits inside "Parent". Nested submenus in beatmap menus, a tree in Manage collections with right-click merge, and hold right-click to drag a collection to merge or move it.

patches.name: Ritsu mods
patches.description: Mods from Ritsu by Azury. One Eye, Decoy Circles and Metronome can be switched off in replays.

patches.name: Torii mods
patches.description: Mods from Torii by ShikkesoraSIM. Hit Sounder and Pitch Adjust, both can be switched off in replays.

patches.name: McOsu mods
patches.description: Mods from McOsu. Mafham and Click Control (Jigsaw 1). Both are osu!std ruleset only for now.

presets.name: Vanilla+
presets.description: Close to vanilla: UI tweaks, play-mod search, replay mod toggles, PP simulation, perfect-play PP sorting, collection folders.

presets.name: Patchsu
presets.description: Every patch: Vanilla+ plus local profiles, the Ritsu, Torii and McOsu mods, mod compatibility, PP options and collection folders.
